zh-CN.name: 微交互
zh-CN.description: 由一个具体触发与针对性反馈组成的小范围交互，例如按钮按压状态、保存结果或输入校验。微交互可以使用文字、状态或动效，不等于所有装饰动画。
use_when: 用户需要确认输入或操作已被识别。
状态变化需要在发生位置附近清楚表达。
avoid_when: 不要让反馈拖延真实操作或掩盖失败。
不要把系统尚未完成的工作提示为成功。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
为具体触发设计明确反馈，区分已接收、处理中、成功与失败；反馈靠近操作位置，兼顾键盘与触摸；动效可以减少或关闭，重要状态仍通过文字或形状保留。
专属演示：收藏操作的触发、选中规则、视觉反馈与状态文本完整演示，可反向取消。 参数：演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Micro-interactions
en.description: A small interaction pairing a specific trigger with focused feedback, such as a pressed state, save result or input validation. Microinteractions may use text, state changes or motion; not every decorative animation qualifies.
use_when: Users need confirmation that input or an action was recognized.
A state change needs clear feedback near its context.
avoid_when: Feedback must not delay real work or hide failure.
Do not report success before the actual operation completes.
en.prompt_template:
Provide focused feedback for a specific trigger, distinguishing receipt, processing, success and failure. Keep feedback near its action and support keyboard and touch. Allow motion reduction while retaining important states through text or shape.
Dedicated demonstration: A complete favorite micro-interaction: trigger, selected-state rule, visual feedback and status text, with reversal. Parameters: demo duration {duration_ms}ms.
